# ClickBench — Google Title Analysis

```{tags} reference, query-template, clickbench
```

> [ClickBench](../../clickbench.md) benchmark · [all ClickBench queries](index.md)

Search phrases for Google titles excluding .google. URLs - case-sensitive LIKE

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  SearchPhrase,
  MIN(URL),
  MIN(Title),
  COUNT(*) AS c,
  COUNT(DISTINCT UserID)
FROM hits
WHERE
  Title LIKE '%Google%' AND NOT URL LIKE '%.google.%' AND SearchPhrase <> ''
GROUP BY
  SearchPhrase
ORDER BY
  c DESC
LIMIT 10
```
